summary: Verify and fix the 21.10 review findings of the FBL audit branch, one agent per file group in its own worktree

issues.what: Reproduced at dd6a52a, offline notifier on the 21.10 06:50Z snapshot with FAKE_NOW=2026-10-21T04:00Z and state.watch=[Vucevic]. Team 6 (Texas 76 Citrus) got '✅ Nikola Vucevic вернулся в строй · 🎯 Тебе: забирай … Уверенность 80%' (Allen→Vucevic, Harper→Herro, McDaniels→Daniels), while its '🧩 Лучший ход' was the package without him. Netting the with- and without-packages gives an edge gain of 84.6, exactly acquisition()'s edge, at 54% confidence. Two more: team 2 Herro shows 76% but his edge is 55%; team 8 Trae Young shows 71% but his edge is 54%. Fix in notify-transfers.mjs: new edgePairs()/dealWhy(). For a package deal, it builds the multiset difference of the with-package against the best package without the player, the same 'without' that acquisition() uses: bestPackage(exclude) when the season-best buys him, otherwise the season-best, and nothing when its gain is 0 or less. Players in both packages cancel. The confidence of that difference drives the 🎯/🤔/nothing gate and the printed % in decide(), the 'вернулся в строй' alert and the 'скоро вернётся' alert. The line now reads 'Уверенность N%, что с ним лучше, чем без него'. The details' 'Откуда' split and the caveats stay those of the moves to make, because flags computed on reversed pairs would be wrong. The back loop now passes best:bestSeason(), and bestPackage(exclude) results are cached per player. Single-swap deals (pack:null) keep the swap's own confidence. Result: the Vucevic alert is no longer sent (54%). Team 5's Vucevic '🤔 68%' package alert is also gone.
issues.tests: tests/review-telegram.test.js: 'a player bought in a package is judged by what he adds…' (synthetic league: the package is near-certain, D51's edge is 57%. The rival message must say '🙅 ничего не делать' with the edge %, and no 'V вернулся в строй' is sent). Also 'a confident edge still says "забирай", with the edge's own percent…' (V's edge 90% against a 98% package: the printed % must equal explainSwap(W→V)). Both fail on dd6a52a.

issues.what: Reproduced on runA (team 0): '🤔 Тебе: можно взять Josh Giddey, но не уверенно … Уверенность 54%: сомнительно' (Booker→Giddey). In decide(), a worth deal whose level is DOUBTFUL (<60%) now returns kind 'none' with head '🙅 Тебе: ничего не делать' and the details 'Если всё же брать X:', the deal lines and the whyLines. heads() already groups 'none'. With 0 transfers left, the 'spent' branch names the next-week deal only when it is not DOUBTFUL. After the fix, runA prints '🙅 Тебе: ничего не делать' with 'Уверенность 54%: сомнительно' in the details. runC (0 transfers left) no longer lists the Giddey next-week deal.

issues.what: Reproduced: at FAKE_NOW 04:00Z (07:00 MSK, window closed), '🧩 Лучший ход … · сделать с 08:00 МСК' but the return alert reads '🎯 Тебе: забирай' with no time, and the soon head is `${head} · ${sureness}`. returnHead() in telegram-format.mjs takes a new `when` option (default '', so the existing season-ui.test.js expectations hold) and appends it to both the 🎯 and 🤔 heads. Reproduced on the 21.10 06:50Z snapshot. It has 64 Sports.ru rows with played:true, points 0 and 20-38 minutes, from the 3 ESPN finals of 20.10 US. The notifier used the raw rows, the app used withBoxScores. Raw against box-scored packages (recommendPackage, month): team 1 78%/+338 → 76%/+284; team 2 86%/+403 → 84%/+348; team 3 79%/+279 → 77%/+202; team 4 78%/+183 → 76%/+127; team 8 76%/+485 → 74%/+426. result.crossGroupNotes:
1. R04/R34, season-core (src/season.js explainSwap, lines 643-646 at dd6a52a). Replace both games flags with one helper that honours gamesBasis, e.g. const gamesFlag=(name,f)=>{const e=f.sources?.espn,m=f.sources?.model;if(!e||!m||Math.abs(e.games-m.games)<12)return null;return f.gamesBasis==='MEAN_ESPN_MODEL'?`${name}: ESPN ждёт ${Math.round(e.games)} матчей, модель по истории пропусков — ${Math.round(m.games)}; в расчёте среднее ${Math.round(f.games)}.`:`${name}: в расчёте ${Math.round(f.games)} матчей по ESPN; по истории пропусков модель ждала бы ${Math.round(m.games)}.`;}. e.games is the figure the mean uses; e.projectedGames is ESPN's uncapped one when a known absence capped it, and could be shown as 'ESPN ждёт P (с учётом травмы E)'. Regression test: forecast {games:58.8,gamesBasis:'MEAN_ESPN_MODEL',sources:{espn:{games:67},model:{games:50.65}}}. The flag must not contain '59 матчей по ESPN' and must contain 'ESPN ждёт 67', '51' and 'среднее 59'. Repro script: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Nba-draft-simulator/bb5a3e80-4ef5-52c7-bdfc-4c0abaeb739b/scratchpad/tg/r04.mjs. Telegram needs no change: it prints why.flags.
2. R06, app side (src/season-ui.js:493 and/or src/season.js contestedBy). The app's 'нужен ещё N командам' still counts rivals with 0 transfers left this week. Suggested: give contestedBy a leftOf(t) callback and skip t when leftOf(t)<=0, or filter in season-ui with the app's own left-of-team (Sports.ru count and fblTransfers). Telegram now filters in notify-transfers.mjs rivalsFor.
3. R01, season-core (optional). acquisition() could return `without` (the best package without the player), or the edge's confidence. The notifier now re-solves bestPackage(exclude) per player (cached), which costs one extra ILP solve. Related design point not changed: pickPackage/recommendPackage gate a package on its total confidence, so a '🧩 Лучший ход' can contain a leg whose own edge is a coin flip. In the synthetic test the 95% package buys D51 (edge 57%), and the rival-release message for D51 now says '🙅 ничего не делать'. Per-leg gating (drop a leg below DOUBTFUL marginal confidence) would remove that tension.
4. R05, src/live.js (not mine). getJson has no request timeout. In the watcher a hung ESPN call blocks the notifier until season_watch's 10-minute subprocess timeout (the existing ESPN injury and news fetches have the same exposure). Consider fetch(url,{cache:'no-cache',signal:AbortSignal.timeout(20e3)}). Also: the app and now Telegram box-score only games of clubs that have an FBL-rostered player (today all 30 clubs).
result.docNotes:
For docs/ACCEPTANCE.md (Telegram advisor, scripts/notify-transfers.mjs). Team numbers below are 1-based.

(a) Buying a player as part of a package (2+ transfers left) is judged by his own edge. The bar and the printed percent are the chance that the package with him beats the best package of the same transfers without him (moves both make cancel out). The details read 'Уверенность N%, что с ним лучше, чем без него: …'. This applies to the rival-release message, '✅ … вернулся в строй' and '🔜 … скоро вернётся'. A single-swap deal keeps the swap's own percent. Live 21.10 (06:50Z snapshot): team 6 Texas 76 Citrus, Vucevic: package 80% (79% box-scored), edge 54%, so no 'вернулся в строй' alert (was '🎯 забирай … 80%'). Team 2 Herro: 76% → 55%. Team 8 Trae Young: 71% → 54%. Team 5's '🤔 Vucevic 68%' package alert is no longer sent.

(b) The bars everywhere in Telegram: ≥70% '🎯 забирай / можно брать'; 60-69% '🤔 … но не уверенно'; below 60% nothing. A released player below 60% gets '🙅 Тебе: ничего не делать' with 'Если всё же брать X:' and the numbers in the details (runA: Giddey 54%, was '🤔 можно взять'). With 0 transfers left the next-week deal is named only from 60%. ACCEPTANCE.md:168 'otherwise the bot offers the move as not sure' should become '60-69% is offered as not sure, below 60% it is not offered'.

(c) Outside 08:00-22:00 MSK every buy line ends with ' · сделать с 08:00 МСК': '🧩 Лучший ход', '🎯 забирай X', '✅ … вернулся в строй', '🔜 … скоро вернётся' and the '📈 Отдельные усиления' header.

(d) Sports.ru rows 'played, 0 points' (not yet counted) are scored from the ESPN box scores in Telegram too, exactly as in the app: yesterday and today US Eastern, clubs of the FBL rosters; a running game waits for the final whistle; with ESPN down the rows stay as listed. 21.10 06:50Z: 64 such rows, 3 finals. Packages raw → box-scored: team 1 78%/+338 → 76%/+284; team 2 86%/+403 → 84%/+348; team 3 79%/+279 → 77%/+202; team 4 78%/+183 → 76%/+127; team 6 79%/+549 (Holmgren→Williamson, Harper→Herro, McDaniels→Bey) → 77%/+622 (Curry→Trae Young, Harper→Herro, McDaniels→Daniels); team 8 76%/+485 → 74%/+426; teams 5 and 7 unchanged. The Telegram package now equals the app's card.

(e) '⚠️ X по модели нужен ещё N командам' in Telegram counts only rivals with transfers left this week. The app still counts all of them until season-ui is changed.

(f) With 0 transfers left the summary has no '📈 Отдельные усиления', and their keys are not used up: the upgrade alerts once transfers reset.

(g) After the R04/R34 season.js fix: the games caveat should read 'ESPN ждёт E, модель M; в расчёте среднее N' for gamesBasis MEAN_ESPN_MODEL.
result.risks:
- R01 recomputes bestPackage(exclude) once per released, returning or soon-returning player when left>1 (cached per id): a few more ILP solves per run (each run took about 1 s on live data here). The 'without' package mirrors acquisition() (exclude when the season-best buys him, else the season-best, nothing when its gain is 0 or less). If season.js changes acquisition's comparison, edgePairs must follow; on live data the netted gain equals acquisition's edge exactly (84.6 = 84.6 for Vucevic).
- The swap path (pack:null, a single swap that alone gains at least 15) with left>1 still shows the swap-vs-nothing percent, not the edge against the best package without him. The finding covered the package path only.
- The '🧩 Лучший ход' can still buy a player whose rival-release message now says '🙅 ничего не делать' (his marginal edge is below 60% while the package is confident). This is per-leg gating in pickPackage, season-core's choice (crossGroupNotes 3).
- R05 adds ESPN scoreboard and summary calls to every notifier run (2 scoreboards plus one summary per started game of the roster clubs). They have no timeout (src/live.js), like the existing ESPN injury and news calls.
- The '📈 Отдельные усиления' header now carries the transfer-hours suffix too, which the finding did not name explicitly.
- The new tests read data/fbl-league.json's white list only to give free agents white-listed ids. If that list ever has fewer than 5 non-draft ids, the fallback ids are not white, and the R06 count for index 7 (which holds no white-listed player) could drop to 1.

issues.what: Reproduced on dd6a52a with a synthetic club schedule (one game every second day from 20.10) and an OFS entry with no date. The 20.10 build gave 0 games and seasonEnding true. The 22.10 build raised TypeError at forecast_basis (back[8:10] on None). Cause: seasonEnding was left<=0 with left=82-blocked, and the block counts from today, so the games already played counted as playable (left=1 on 22.10). Fix in apply(): left = the club games from the return date to the season end, blocked_games(until,'9999-12-31',dates). An undated or after-season ending entry therefore leaves 0 games and gets seasonEnding true. forecast_basis also prints 'вне игры до конца сезона' when returnDate is missing, so the build cannot crash on that path. Builds on 20.10, 22.10 and 10.01 now give 0 games, seasonEnding true and returnDate null.

issues.what:
Reproduced. The old absence(Furphy) returned ('out','2027-01-02'). The old regex missed 'season-ending', 'entirety of the 2026-27 season', 'remainder of the season' and 'rest of the regular season'. Even a matching comment blocked only up to ESPN's placeholder date. In a production rebuild on 21.10 with the live ESPN report, old code gave Furphy 33.4 games, 235 FP and the basis 'пропустит 34 матча клуба (до 02.01)'.

The new season_ending() mirrors season.js seasonEnding:
- OFS counts as season-ending.
- Otherwise the entry must be kept out (status Out or Suspension, not GTD, like JS keptOut) and the comment must have a clause (split on . ; , ! ? and spaced dashes) that matches ENDING with no EARLIER marker.
- ENDING: 'out for the season', 'season-ending', 'miss the (entire/rest of the/remainder of the) season', '(remainder|rest|entirety|balance) of the season', each optionally with '2026-27 ' and/or 'regular ' before 'season', never followed by 'opener'.
- EARLIER: 'last/previous/past/prior season or year', 'a year ago', 'returning/recovering/working back/coming back from', a season tag YYYY-YY or 'in/during [word] YYYY' with YYYY < 2026.

In known_absence, an ending entry blocks to the season end whatever date it carries. A date inside the season becomes 9999-12-31 and returnDate is null; a date after the season end (Hukporti 2027-10-01) is kept.

Results:
- The 21.10 rebuild gives Furphy 0 games, seasonEnding true and returnDate null.
- Of 136 distinct live and archived ESPN comments, only Veesaar, Furphy, Oweh, Hukporti and Simmons read as season-ending.
- Python agrees with all 30 cases of the new shared fixture. The current JS disagrees on 8 of them (3 'regular season' phrasings, 5 past-injury mentions), which is exactly R16.

issues.what:
Reproduced as described. A season-ending player's slotSeason is 80 x the position's replacement level with 0 own points. In the 21.10 rebuild: Hukporti 1039 (rank 78 of 480 priced), Simmons 1007 (rank 93), and after R31 Furphy 926 (rank 241 -> 116).

This is the slot value applied exactly, not an error. Drafting him and swapping him for the best free agent at his position yields the replacement for the season after the two-game delay. Before the season, swaps were free until 20.10 21:30, so that is the true value of the pick. The healthy players he outranks have slots below that same replacement level (Claxton 994, Raynaud 1056 at C level 12.99 per game). The board ranking them below a free-agent stream is the slot model's statement about them, not a bonus for injury.

The holdout target treats a zero-game season the same way (actual_replaced(None,n)=n-delay), and the existing test test_out_for_the_season_means_no_games pins 80 replaced games. ACCEPTANCE line 190 documents the credit.

The real caveats apply to every slot, not only season-ending ones: the replacement level is an untested assumption, and the replacement's Sports.ru price is never charged. That belongs to slot-value-math (see crossGroupNotes). It does not affect the season either: in season, decisions use expectedPoints, not slotSeason. No code change.
issues.tests: none (the existing tests/test_projection_inputs.py test_out_for_the_season_means_no_games already pins 80 replaced games)

issues.what:
Reproduced on dd6a52a. The 2023 class has 43 undrafted rows, including Patty Mills (NBA id 201988, since 2009), who is absent from the career parquet so first=2024. 'Sasha Vezenkov' is not a veteran: his NBA debut was 2023-24, after being drafted in 2017 (#57) as 'Aleksandar Vezenkov'. He is a late-debuting pick counted as undrafted because the names differ.

The reviewer's proposed fix is already in the code: history.first already holds every career-parquet player's seasons, and the official index has only 526 current players. So neither example is caught by it.

New rule: rookie_rows(known=history.collected), the 799 players with collected NBA career logs. An undrafted debutant must be among them, because without logs an earlier season cannot be ruled out. It applies to all three classes for consistency. It also removes Nigel Hayes-Davis (NBA id 1628502, no logs) from the 2025 test class. It drops three true debutants without logs (Mensah 25 games, Hurt 8, Cui Yongxi 5).

Undrafted rows by class: 2023 43 -> 40, 2024 48 -> 47, 2025 48 -> 47.

- undrafted 79.14% on 278 rows -> 79.10% on 268
- all 73.57% on 628 -> 73.62% on 618

Rookie fit, undrafted:
- rate 3.745 -> 3.812

In production, the undrafted rookies' games go from 13.41 to 13.35.

issues.what:
The claim is wrong on dd6a52a and on the reviewed commits 24c6897 and 967f2c6 alike. season_length(2020) without club calendars returns 72; the 63 is only the floor inside the club-calendar branch, unchanged since #39. av.season_games(2020) is also 72.

So deployed() uses n=72, and with_games/distribution builds the chain over L=season_games(2020)=72. Ranges.__init__ calls raw(q,x,season_length(2020)=72) on a pmf of length 73, so g=arange(73)*72/72 and nothing is rescaled. No code change.

1. season-core (R16, src/season.js seasonEnding): please align with the new shared fixture tests/fixtures/season-ending-comments.json (30 report entries with the expected 'ending'). Add a JS test such as `for(const c of cases)assert.equal(seasonEnding(c),c.ending,c.comment)`.
   - The current JS fails 8 of the 30: the 3 'rest/remainder of the (2026-27) regular season' cases and 5 past-injury mentions ('work back from the season-ending surgery he underwent in March', 'since returning from a season-ending Achilles tear suffered in 2025', 'who missed the remainder of the season last year', 'was out for the season last year', 'who suffered a season-ending knee injury in 2025').
   - Python rule (scripts/projection_model.py season_ending): OFS, or keptOut plus a clause where ENDING matches and no EARLIER marker does. Clauses are split on /[.;,!?]+|\s[-–—]+\s/.
   - ENDING: `\bout for (?:the )?T|\bseason[- ]ending\b|\bmiss(?:es)? the (?:entire |rest of the |remainder of the )?T|\b(?:remainder|rest|entirety|balance) of the T`, with T=`(?:2026-27 )?(?:regular[- ])?season\b(?![- ]opener)`.
   - EARLIER: `\b(?:last|previous|past|prior) (?:season|year)\b`, `\ba year ago\b`, `(?:return(?:s|ed|ing)?|recover(?:s|ed|ing|y)?|work(?:s|ed|ing)?(?: his way)? back|coming back) from`, a tag YYYY-YY with YYYY<2026, or 'in/during [word] YYYY' with YYYY<2026.
   - If season-core settles on other rules, change the fixture so both sides pass it.
2. season-ui (R20/R27): forecast.knownAbsence.returnDate is now null for a season-ending entry whose ESPN date falls inside the season (Furphy), and seasonEnding is true. Labels should come from seasonEnding(injury) or knownAbsence.seasonEnding, not ESPN's returnDate ('до ~02.01').
3. season-core playRate: forecast.games of a player with forecast.knownAbsence counts only the games after his return. Before the season it already did; now it also holds in season, from the build day. While the live report keeps him out, playRate uses max(games, unconditionalGames), which is fine. Once the live report clears and until the next daily build, the prior games/82 understates him: Mark Williams 23.9/82=0.29 against an unconditional 52.2/82=0.64. Suggest max(games, availability.unconditionalGames ?? sources.model.games) whenever forecast.knownAbsence is set.
4. slot-value-math (R35, not changed): if the league wants season-ending players ranked below healthy replacement-level players, the place is slot_values (for example no transfer credit when knownAbsence.seasonEnding). It would also mean changing the expectation of tests/test_projection_inputs.py test_out_for_the_season_means_no_games (replacedGames 80). Note that the replacement's Sports.ru price is charged nowhere in the slot value, and that R31 raises Furphy from rank 241 to 116 by slot (0 own points, slot 926).
5. docs-truth / verify-build (optional): assert that every v4 forecast with knownAbsence.seasonEnding has games 0, and that knownAbsence.returnDate null implies seasonEnding.

Add to «Current state» (or the injury-report entry):
- Season-ending entries: an ESPN report entry is season-ending when it is OFS, or when it keeps the player out (Out/Suspension, not GTD) and a clause of its comment about this season says 'season-ending', 'out for the season' or 'rest/remainder/entirety of the (2026-27) (regular) season'. Not the 'season opener', and not a clause about an earlier injury ('last season's…', 'returning from…', an earlier year or season tag). Such an entry gives 0 games whatever placeholder return date ESPN shows, in the build as in the season tab. The 30 shared cases are in tests/fixtures/season-ending-comments.json.

result.risks:
- Past-injury guard: a clause that mixes a current season-ending phrase with an earlier year or a 'returned from' is read as not ending. Example: 'will miss the entire 2026-27 season after tearing his Achilles in May 2025' in one clause. Such a player then gets games after ESPN's date unless ESPN also sets OFS. No live comment has that shape; please check that the JS side, which is being changed in parallel, agrees on the shared fixture.
- In-season meaning of forecast.games: for a known-absence player it is now the games after the return (from the build day), matching the pre-season meaning. Healthy players keep their full-season figure. The UI says «Прогноз до сезона»; the JS consumer note is crossGroupNote 3.
- known_absence turns an in-season placeholder date of a season-ending entry into 9999-12-31, so knownAbsence.returnDate becomes null for those players (Furphy). Dates after the season end are kept (Hukporti and Simmons 2027-10-01).
- The R38 rule drops undrafted debutants whose careers were never collected (3 true debutants over three classes). It changes the production undrafted-rookie prior slightly (games 13.41 -> 13.35 for 14 rookies).
- R35 is a modelling judgement (not-a-bug). R31 makes it more visible: Furphy moves to slot rank 116 with 0 own points.
- R40 and the 'past injury keeps its date' test pass on the old code too: they guard behaviour rather than reproduce a failure.
